method: Refit every Murcko S0 fold model (25 nonbenzene CV folds + benzene holdout) from Phase 6D selected hyperparameters, compare with stored out-of-fold predictions, and time sampled units of each planned diagnostic; extrapolated to the configured repeats and units.
notes: The ALE estimate assumes every training row is predicted twice per bin; the real ALE predicts only rows inside each bin, so it is an upper bound.
Fold-level work can be parallelised across folds without nested threading because every estimator uses n_jobs=1.
